Pinned host source, Emby.Server.Implementations/ScheduledTasks/ScheduledTaskWorker.cs: GetDefaultTriggers() is invoked for a task with no saved trigger file; GetTrigger handles TaskTriggerInfoType.IntervalTrigger and requires IntervalTicks (a null IntervalTicks would throw); ExecuteInternal awaits ExecuteAsync and classifies OperationCanceledException as Cancelled.
